title: Comparing Your Real Options for Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure for Digital Creators — No Stripe Required
author: COREMERCH
excerpt: No KYC. No platform risk. No dependency. Revenue flows to a wallet you control. The infrastructure layer that makes platforms optional.
imageAlt: Sovereign commerce stack ownership — no platform dependency — for digital creators in Bangladesh
imageCaption: You own the storefront, the customer list, the order history, and the wallet. COREMERCH has no access after deployment.

content.text: Digital creators in restricted countries face an existential threat when popular payment platforms like Stripe freeze their accounts and withhold funds. This happened in Zimbabwe when the government froze bank accounts and restricted access to USD. For those in Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, Philippines, and other regions where Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle are unavailable or severely restricted, the lack of sovereignty over their store infrastructure is a constant worry. The infrastructure problem is not just about platforms; it's about owning the code, customer data, and order history – not renting them from a third-party service that can freeze or shut down your store at any moment. This post will compare three real options for sovereign commerce infrastructure that allow digital creators to control their store [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-2|The Real]]-behind-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/google-apps-script-digital-commerce-automation-what-actually-4|COREMERCH guide to google]]-apps-script-digital-commerce-4|architecture]], avoid platform suspension, and maintain ownership over their digital product income.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure for Digital Creators at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/coremerch-sovereign-stack-deployment-guide-what-nobody-tells-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure for Digital Creators

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers

The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) is a GitHub Pages-based infrastructure setup that includes Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. It's ideal for small digital creators who want to get started with sovereign commerce infrastructure. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is a more comprehensive setup that includes Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, with additional features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration and end-to-end testing. Finally, the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) is a comprehensive documentation package that includes the source code for all five stacks, NOWPayments integration guides, and a scaling playbook. For those who want a more comprehensive solution, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) offers all six blueprints plus seven templates, instant download, and everything needed to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

All three options are designed to work in restricted countries, but they differ in their approach. The Sovereign Starter Stack uses GitHub Pages, which has a wide reach and can be accessed from anywhere in the world. The Edge Commerce Stack uses Cloudflare Pages, which also has a wide reach but has more advanced features than GitHub Pages. The Sovereign Blueprint is a documentation package that can be used in conjunction with any of the other two options to provide a comprehensive solution. In terms of payment processing, NOWPayments is a key player in providing a cryptocurrency payment gateway that works with 300+ cryptocurrencies and has no KYC requirements, making it accessible to digital creators in restricted countries.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment speed, fees, and real costs, the three options differ. The Sovereign Starter Stack uses NOWPayments, which has a 0.5% fee for on-chain transactions. The Edge Commerce Stack also uses NOWPayments but with additional features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration, which can help reduce the risk of email spoofing and improve deliverability. The Sovereign Blueprint is a documentation package and does not have any fees associated with it. In terms of real costs, the Sovereign Starter Stack is the most affordable option at $97, followed by the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. The Sovereign Blueprint is a one-time purchase of $47, making it a cost-effective solution for those who want a comprehensive documentation package.
Using a reliable hosting provider like Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages is crucial for a sovereign digital commerce stack.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

All three options offer a high degree of ownership, automation, and delivery. The Sovereign Starter Stack allows digital creators to own their store infrastructure, customer data, and order history, while the Edge Commerce Stack offers additional features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration and end-to-end testing. The Sovereign Blueprint is a comprehensive documentation package that provides a clear understanding of how to implement sovereign commerce infrastructure. In terms of automation, both the Sovereign Starter Stack and the Edge Commerce Stack use Cloudflare Workers and Supabase to automate tasks and improve delivery. The Sovereign Blueprint also provides guidance on how to automate tasks using Cloudflare Workers and Supabase.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The choice of architecture depends on the digital creator's situation. For small creators who want to get started with sovereign commerce infrastructure, the Sovereign Starter Stack is a great option. For more advanced creators who want additional features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration and end-to-end testing, the Edge Commerce Stack is a better choice. For those who want a comprehensive documentation package that provides a clear understanding of how to implement sovereign commerce infrastructure, the Sovereign Blueprint is a great option. Finally, for those who want a more comprehensive solution that includes all six blueprints plus seven templates, instant download, and everything needed to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) is the way to go.
What does sovereign commerce infrastructure mean for digital creators?

Sovereign infrastructure means the creator owns every component of their commerce operation — not as a policy promise, but as a technical reality. The storefront code is in your GitHub or Cloudflare account. The customer email list is in your Supabase database or Google Sheet. The order and payment history is exportable as CSV at any time from your own database. The product files are in your Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The NOWPayments account is registered under your email address. The wallet addresses and all funds inside them were never touched by COREMERCH. COREMERCH has no access after delivery.
Configuring SPF/DKIM/DMARC can help reduce the risk of email spoofing and improve deliverability.

For a more comprehensive solution, consider purchasing the Complete Builder Kit ($197) which includes all six blueprints plus seven templates, instant download. You can also visit our shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to purchase other products that can help you build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack.
Your Deployment Checklist

Move any existing revenue out of platform custodial accounts and into a self-custody wallet you control — Trust Wallet for mobile, MetaMask for browser, hardware wallet for larger amounts. Create a NOWPayments account and configure it with your self-custody wallet addresses — funds route directly to your wallet on every transaction with no platform holding period. Deploy your sovereign stack under your own accounts — GitHub or Cloudflare, your choice of database, your NOWPayments API key, your delivery email service. Confirm that your order database gives you an independent transaction record that does not depend on any platform's continued operation. Complete a mainnet test transaction and verify the complete pipeline before promoting.
